newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: U.S.-S.Korea cancel war games in gesture to North.
newsitem.headline: U.S.-S.Korea cancel war games in gesture to North.

text.p: South Korea and the United States have cancelled joint war games this year in a gesture aimed at easing tensions on the Korean peninsula, South Korea's defence ministry announced on Thursday.
Pyongyang bitterly denounces the "Team Spirit" military exercises as preparation for an invasion.
The cancellation was announced hours after U.S. and South Korean officials met North Korean representatives in New York for a briefing on proposed peace talks for the Korean peninsula.

"The decision to cancel Team Spirit is part of efforts by our two governments to build confidence and to create an atmosphere conducive to the reduction of tensions on the peninsula," the defence ministry statement said.
It added the decision would have no impact on the defence readiness of U.S. and South Korean forces.
